_comment: Each step names its own provider + model. Swap any step independently here, or override with env vars PIPELINE_<STEP>_PROVIDER / PIPELINE_<STEP>_MODEL (e.g. PIPELINE_WRITE_PROVIDER=openai-compatible). Keys are never stored here — only the NAME of the env var that holds them.

openai-compatible._comment: For DeepSeek or any OpenAI-compatible API. Not active until chosen for the write step.

ollama._comment: Local model via Ollama. Not active until chosen for the write step.
